entities.name: HGNC:42
observations: ABCB11 encodes the bile salt export pump; the reviewed studies evaluated variant effects on its RNA splicing.

entities.name: ABCB11 c.3003A>G
observations: Synonymous variant; abnormal ABCB11 splicing was detected in liver transcripts from a PFIC2 patient study that analyzed liver tissue from five patients and 11 variants.

entities.name: ABCB11 c.3213+4A>G
observations: Intronic variant; abnormal ABCB11 splicing was detected in liver transcripts in the same PFIC2 patient study.

entities.name: ABCB11 c.150+3A>C
observations: Intronic variant; patient liver RNA showed partial exon 3 skipping, while a minigene showed complete exon 3 skipping with some correctly spliced transcript also present in liver tissue.

entities.name: ABCB11 c.76+29T>G
observations: Intronic variant; assay-derived mature mRNA retained 42 base pairs, supporting an altered splice product; this was not direct liver-transcript evidence.

entities.name: ABCB11 c.390-2A>G
observations: Intronic variant; assay-derived transcripts showed exon 6 skipping, supporting an altered splice product; this was not direct liver-transcript evidence.

entities.name: PMID:25085279
observations: Study of ABCB11 variants in liver tissue from five PFIC2 patients; among 11 variants, c.3003A>G and c.3213+4A>G produced abnormal transcripts. The accessible abstract does not specify the exact splice products.
